# The Precursor heritage (doc 68, section 4): elven or Ruinborn, the country's race or a former race kept.

}
# The elven or Ruinborn texts of the window: the Ruinborn's own when that is the country's race.
DA_EL_is_ruinborn = {
	DA_RH_primary_ruinborn = yes
	NOT = { DA_RH_primary_elven = yes }
}

# Recollection: an Elven research runs that has not been recollected

		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Nec2 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Nec2 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Nec3 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Nec3 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Nec4 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Nec4 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Tra1 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Tra1 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Tra2 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Tra2 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Tra3 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Tra3 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Tra4 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Tra4 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Fra1 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Fra1 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Fra2 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Fra2 } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_EL_Fra3 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_rec.EL_Fra3 } }
	}
}
# A country of the heritage that can take the diplomatic actions (doc 68, section 7.4)
